headline: India launches $1.5 billion energy storage initiative
summary: The Indian government has introduced a $1.5 billion scheme to develop 92 gigawatt-hours of energy storage capacity. The project aims to accelerate the country's transition toward renewable energy sources.
why: India is one of the world's fastest-growing economies and a significant energy consumer. Large-scale investments in energy infrastructure are critical for its long-term industrial and climate goals.

impacts.name: Renewable Energy
impacts.why: Government subsidies and infrastructure spending directly benefit the renewable energy sector.
